title: Pregnancy danger signs and birth go bag
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for birth-plan papers, transport routes, clean supplies, and urgent pregnancy warning signs.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: bleeding, severe headache, vision changes, swelling face, seizure, fever, severe belly pain, or reduced baby movement.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: bleeding, severe headache, vision changes, swelling face, seizure, fever, severe belly pain, or reduced baby movement

title: Emergency birth clean support boundary
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for clean hands, clean surface, warmth, privacy, emergency contact, and no unnecessary pulling.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: heavy bleeding, breech, cord problem, baby not breathing, mother faint, fever, or long labor.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: heavy bleeding, breech, cord problem, baby not breathing, mother faint, fever, or long labor

title: Postpartum bleeding infection and mood watch
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for checking bleeding amount, fever, pain, mood, support, and newborn feeding after birth.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: soaking pads fast, bad smell, fever, severe sadness, confusion, self-harm thoughts, or baby not feeding.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: soaking pads fast, bad smell, fever, severe sadness, confusion, self-harm thoughts, or baby not feeding

title: Newborn warmth breathing and feeding watch
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for keeping newborn warm, dry, close, feeding observed, and breathing monitored.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: blue color, grunting, fast breathing, poor feeding, fever, low temperature, limpness, or no wet diapers.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: blue color, grunting, fast breathing, poor feeding, fever, low temperature, limpness, or no wet diapers
